approvedScope: Source-verified recommended rows reviewed by repository and functional purpose; exact-path coverage only. No featured status, new broad trust roles, combined crawl or publication.
reviewNotes: Reviewed source, package references and attribution; manual held repos are documented separately. Service/CLI prerequisites allowed, no skill execution.

manualReview.notes: Conservative source/package review. Service and CLI prerequisites are allowed; copied packs, unavailable companion runtimes, and connector-only forwarding stubs are held. Holds do not create owner blocks or alter existing library entries.
